Hmmmm, I take issue with one of the statements in that imgur post, the one that says something along the lines of "nobody HAS to live in a fat body or an underweight one".

I agree that nobody has to be fat (if my sister can have her thyroid removed due to cancer and manage to stay healthy then "muh thyroid" excuses can fuck off)... I really don't have a choice about being underweight though.

I have a paralysed digestive system and I'm fed via a tube in my intestine. I can't physically absorb enough calories to gain weight and never will be able to.

There are also plenty of people with horrible diseases like crohns who have had to have most of their bowels removed. Many of them are fed via a tube or through an IV and they can't help being underweight either.

Not to mention all those people around the world that don't have access to enough food every day. They definitely don't have a choice about being underweight!

Sure, if you have a "normal" body, access to enough food to sustain yourself and you just don't feed it enough (whether through mental illnesses like anorexia or just because you want to be skinny) then you do technically have a choice. People like that can gain weight if they eat the right amount, but there are many legitimate reasons why somebody would be incapable of gaining weight.

So unfortunately, I do have to live in an underweight body and it's most definitely not my choice! I've spent years of my life dedicated to the goal of gaining weight and staying alive while getting fucking nowhere.

If all fatties tried as hard to lose as I do to gain then obesity wouldn't exist.

In 20, years when our economy & healthcare systems is literally collapsing under the weight obesity, I hope you all make it clear that it was people like this who are contributed our economic downfall (or blow up, depending on how you look at it).
